description: Medusa v2.8: `medusa ui` — local-first web dashboard (React+TS, Abyss dark theme) with live SSE snapshots, attack map, three-tier traffic monitor scored by the real blue detector, force-directed knowledge graph, pipeline viz, reports browser.
